profile.summary: milaninfy is a senior-level JavaScript engineer with deep expertise in npm CLI internals, specializing in dependency resolution, workspaces, and asynchronous package management. Their contributions focus on low-level npm functionality—fixing core issues in package publishing, caching, and Git dependency handling. The developer demonstrates strong skills in Node.js runtime behavior, version compatibility checks, and resilient error handling, with a particular focus on npm's internal tools like arborist and pacote. Their work spans both technical fixes and documentation improvements, reflecting a balance of debugging and UX considerations in a production-grade package manager.

Versioning & Compatibility: Version range logic in npm outdated
Git Integration: Git hash ref support in npm pack/exec
